Julian Nott | Julian Nott (born Julian Franklin Keith Nott, 23 August 1960) is a British film composer, mostly of animated films.  He is best known for his work on the "Wallace and Gromit" films and Peppa Pig animations.
Wallace and Gromit's World of Invention | Wallace and Gromit's World of Invention is a science-themed miniseries featuring the animated claymation characters Wallace and Gromit, made by Aardman and aired on BBC One.
